# MedCrave Online

> > MedCrave Online is an open-access academic publisher hosting peer-reviewed journals across medical sciences, engineering, and interdisciplinary research fields.

MedCrave publishes journals spanning bacteriology, mycology, hematology, nanomedicine, psychology, dermatology, fluid mechanics, civil engineering, and clinical case reports. The platform maintains international editorial and reviewer boards with experts from institutions worldwide, including contributors from India, United States, Sudan, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-review process
- Medical research journals
- Editorial boards
- Bacteriology and mycology
- Hematology and transfusion medicine
- Nanomedicine and drug delivery
- Fluid mechanics and engineering

- Dermatology and cosmetology

- Obstetrics and gynecology
- Respiratory research

## Medical & Clinical Journals

- [Obstetrics & Gynecology International Journal - OGIJ](https://medcraveonline.com/OGIJ/index): Women's health & reproductive medicine open-access journal homepage
- [Hematology & Transfusion International Journal - HTIJ](https://medcraveonline.com/HTIJ/index): Peer-reviewed hematology & transfusion medicine journal homepage
- [MOJ Clinical & Medical Case Reports - MOJCR](https://medcraveonline.com/MOJCR): Clinical case studies & medical reports peer-reviewed journal homepage
- [Journal of Dermatology & Cosmetology - JDC](https://medcraveonline.com/JDC): Skin disorders & dermatology research journal with case reports
- [Journal of Nanomedicine Research - JNMR](https://medcraveonline.com/JNMR/index): Nanotechnology & drug delivery research journal with clinical focus

## Engineering & Physical Sciences Journals

- [Fluid Mechanics Research International Journal - FMRIJ](https://medcraveonline.com/FMRIJ/index): Engineering journal covering hydraulics, turbulent flow & fluid mechanics
- [MOJ Civil Engineering - MOJCE](https://medcraveonline.com/MOJCE): Civil engineering & construction materials open-access journal
- [MOJ Polymer Science](https://medcraveonline.com/MOJPS/reviewer-board): MOJ Polymer Science reviewer board with experts from Hungary and beyond

## Editorial & Reviewer Boards

- [Journal of Bacteriology & Mycology Reviewer Board](https://medcraveonline.com/JBMOA/reviewer-board): JBMOA reviewer board featuring experts like Mohammed Elfatih Ahmed
- [Journal of Psychology & Clinical Psychiatry Reviewer Board](https://medcraveonline.com/JPCPY/reviewer-board): Editorial reviewers for psychology & psychiatry journal including Amita Puri
- [MOJ Tumor Research Reviewer Board](https://medcraveonline.com/MOJTR/reviewer-board): Cancer research reviewers including Dr Hafeez Ullah Janjua from Pakistan
- [Journal of Lung, Pulmonary & Respiratory Research Reviewer Board](https://medcraveonline.com/JLPRR/reviewer-board): Respiratory research reviewers from Michigan State University and more
- [Fluid Mechanics Research International Journal Reviewer Board](https://medcraveonline.com/FMRIJ/reviewer-board): FMRIJ editorial reviewers including Dr Pinku Debnath from India

## Publishing Guidelines & Resources

- [Editor Guidelines](https://medcraveonline.com/editor-guidelines): MedCrave editorial board guidelines for manuscript evaluation & review
